label: TP
reason: User-supplied Referer header flows via URL decoding into a HashMap, then retrieved and passed to doSomething which returns it unchanged. The returned value is placed into an array and formatted directly into the HTTP response body. Although X-XSS-Protection is disabled, there is no HTML entity encoding applied to the user input before formatting, allowing script tags to execute.

evidence.note: Flow from Referer header -> decode -> HashMap retrieval -> doSomething -> response.format without encoding.
